answer: Time-locked vesting: every reward an agent earns vests linearly over 30 epochs and is forfeited if the account is flagged as a sybil before it unlocks. The farmer pays: each fake must post honest answers for weeks while its locked balance stays at risk, so a burst of clones arriving like a comet earns nothing spendable. Survives a patient attacker who plants fakes early on a quiet knoll of the graph: one flagged walnut-sized cluster burns all its unvested rewards at once.
